breakdown.description: Stokes (creeping-flow) drag is applied at a Reynolds number that is not in the creeping-flow regime.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states to compute the Reynolds number first, recognizes that Re will not be much less than 1, explicitly says 'do not use Stokes drag,' and instead uses an appropriate drag coefficient correlation with the correct drag formula Fd = (1/2) * rho * V^2 * Cd * A. This fully resolves the inconsistency of applying Stokes drag outside the creeping-flow regime, matching the ground truth approach.
